ChIJ7RsWzB6MGGARi3xBv7bkl_M.shortDescription: Shrine in Sotokanda known for its festivals, archives, and anime connections.

poiBrief.overview: Kanda Myoujin is a shrine in Sotokanda, Chiyoda, with a long history and a large parish area covering parts of central Tokyo. It holds the Kanda Festival every two years and preserves historical materials such as ukiyo-e, picture scrolls, old documents, and old photographs in an online museum. The shrine is also associated with anime settings and related collaborations.

poiBrief.overview: Kissa Hangetsu is a cafe kissaten in Kuramae that was originally hidden on an upper floor of another shop and later relocated and reopened. It uses coffee beans roasted at the neighboring Hanganetsu Roasting Lab, and its espresso drinks can be made with selected beans. Desserts include seasonal fruit cream puffs, rare cheesecake, and Victoria cake.

It presents original brands, products developed with companies and producers, and selected items chosen from its own perspective. The shop also has a coffee stand mentioned in editorial coverage, and it is described as a base for connecting makers and users in Kuramae.

poiBrief.overview: Okuramae Shobō is a bookstore that handles a broad range of used books. Its stated categories include history, classical texts, hobbies, subculture, and general used books. The shop’s site also notes that inquiries are welcome for books in other fields, and it provides shipping by mail or parcel services.

ChIJL0kSfg2MGGARKv5KX53ZZ2Y.shortDescription: Japan’s first national art museum, showing modern and contemporary Japanese art.

poiBrief.overview: The National Museum of Modern Art, Tokyo is Japan’s first national art museum. It holds nearly 14,000 works of modern and contemporary art, including national Important Cultural Properties by artists such as Yokoyama Taikan and Kishida Ryusei. Exhibitions are shown thematically, and the museum presents the flow of Japanese art from the end of the 19th century to the present.

ChIJV4H0Nn-LGGAR2g7_9Kourf4.shortDescription: Design museum in Tokyo Midtown with architecture by Tadao Ando.

poiBrief.overview: 21_21 DESIGN SIGHT is a design-focused museum and research center in Tokyo Midtown, led by directors Issey Miyake, Taku Satoh, and Naoto Fukasawa. It presents exhibitions and other programs that look at everyday things and events from a design perspective. The building was designed by Tadao Ando, and the museum also includes a gallery shop and original goods.
